{\scriptsize\raggedright
\textit{Population:} BASE paired with FINAL[v] (identical base-cell cohort). \textit{Unit:} base cell.
\textit{CI:} 95\% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full\_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted); 10,000 replicates for the primary-family estimates (R04 composite with strata endpoint+variant; Holm-adjusted tests in T9); 12 interval(s) of zero width marked \dag{}.
Paired by base cell; a successful repair is an improvement on the endpoint (R02), terminal statuses play no role; net gain = (improved - regressed) / cells; BASE, FINAL[v] and R02-R04 rest on the identical base cells (checked).
Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): no unit is excluded in this table by Q06 (baseline\_incompatible artifact(s)); R02 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort); R03 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort); R04 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort).
BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.
REASONING: Reasoning settings differ between models and are not equalised (see the closure disclosure register, item reasoning\_policy\_differences); some providers report no reasoning-token field.
IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.
IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01.
IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.
\textit{Definitions} (methodology; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; FINAL; Q06 correctness\_pass; R02 repair\_success\_rate; R03 regression\_rate; R04 net\_gain.\par
\textsuperscript{a}~pilot: pilot\_002 / Pilotexperiment (12 benchmarks x 3 execution models x 11 models, 1 sample per prompt); pilot block has 12 clusters: percentile intervals are approximate; flagged in every pilot table\par
\textsuperscript{\dag}~Degenerate percentile interval (zero width): every supporting cluster has the same value (a share at 0\% or 100\%, or a difference of 0); the bootstrap cannot express the sampling uncertainty.\par
